name: TriLinc Global Impact Fund, LLC
summary: TriLinc Global Impact Fund, LLC, operating through its various entities, is dedicated to financing small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). The fund primarily capitalizes its investments by issuing units to investors. It then channels these funds into a diverse range of financial instruments—including direct loans, loan participations, convertible debt, trade finance solutions, structured credit, and both preferred and common equity stakes—managed by local market sub-advisors. Beyond its SME focus, TriLinc also allocates capital to opportunities within developed economies. The company was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Manhattan Beach, California.
